description: Read-only. Who this secret key is: the workspace name, its link domain (the host every shortUrl uses, e.g. hilltop.strait.link or a verified custom domain), custom domains, the plan, what the key may do (full, links or read) and the saved QR styles (qrStyles: their id is the preset for get_link_qr and get_campaign_qr_zip). Call it first when you need the link domain (for check_app_links) or to know whether the key can write.
name: get_workspace
title: Read the workspace and key
